```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

source("parse_bib.R")

pubs <- parse_bib("publications.bib")

# Convert list to data frame
to_row <- function(e) {
  data.frame(
    key     = e$key     %||% "",
    type    = e$type    %||% "",
    title   = e$title   %||% "",
    author  = e$author  %||% "",
    journal = e$journal %||% "",
    year    = suppressWarnings(as.integer(e$year %||% "0")),
    volume  = e$volume  %||% "",
    number  = e$number  %||% "",
    pages   = e$pages   %||% "",
    doi     = e$doi     %||% "",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pubs, to_row))
df <- df[order(-df$year, df$author), ]

# Highlight PI name
highlight_pi <- function(s) {
  gsub("(Rafa[łl]?\\s+(?:J\\.?\\s+)?Mostowy)", '<span class="pi">\\1</span>', s, perl = TRUE)
}

# Journal badge
journal_badge <- function(journal) {
  jl <- tolower(journal)
  if (grepl("biorxiv", jl))
    return('<span class="pub-badge badge-preprint">Preprint</span> ')
  return(sprintf('<span class="pub-badge badge-published">%s</span> ', journal))
}

years <- sort(unique(df$year[df$year > 0]), decreasing = TRUE)

cat('<div class="pub-list">\n')

for (yr in years) {
  sub <- df[df$year == yr, ]
  cat(sprintf(
    '<div class="pub-year-group">\n<div class="pub-year-label">%d</div>\n', yr
  ))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sub))) {
    p <- sub[i, ]

    doi_link <- if (nchar(trimws(p$doi)) > 0)
      sprintf(' <a href="https://doi.org/%s" target="_blank" class="pub-doi">doi →</a>',
              trimws(p$doi))
    else ""

    vol_str <- ""
    if (nchar(p$volume) > 0 && nchar(p$number) > 0)
      vol_str <- sprintf(" %s(%s)", p$volume, p$number)
    else if (nchar(p$volume) > 0)
      vol_str <- sprintf(" %s", p$volume)

    pages_str <- if (nchar(p$pages) > 0) sprintf(":%s", p$pages) else ""
    badge     <- journal_badge(p$journal)

    cat(sprintf(
'<div class="pub-item">
  <div class="pub-title">%s%s</div>
  <div class="pub-authors">%s</div>
  <div class="pub-journal"><em>%s</em>%s%s%s</div>
</div>\n',
      badge, p$title,
      highlight_pi(format_authors(p$author)),
      p$journal, vol_str, pages_str, doi_link
    ))
  }

  cat('</div>\n')
}

cat('</div>\n')
```
